single_factor: representation of the 8 non-geo text categoricals inside LightGBM while geo_level_1/2/3_id stay one-hot (relative to T8 arm O); equivalently geo one-hot instead of native relative to T8 arm N

arms.P: T8 make_preprocessor('O') (C age policy, scaled numeric + binary + age_is_995, float32) except the categorical path is split: the 8 text categoricals -> OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown='use_encoded_value', unknown_value=NaN, encoded_missing_value=NaN, dtype=float32) fitted on the training fold only, placed at columns 28..35 and declared via categorical_feature; geo_level_1/2/3_id -> OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', sparse_output=True, dtype=float32) fitted on the training fold only (same estimator as O), placed after the codes. Output is float32 CSR (sparse_threshold 1.0); implicit zeros are code 0 (zero_as_missing=false), unseen NaN codes are stored explicitly. Identical LGBMClassifier params.

reference_arms.O: T8 arm O (one-hot all 11); stratified = pinned T4 LGBM_C_v1 OOF, geo2/geo1 = T8 study OOF; not refit
reference_arms.N: T8 arm N (native all 11); T8 study OOF for all three schemes; not refit
reference_arms.LR_C: research baseline LR-C OOF; not refit

matrix_format: scipy CSR float32; never a full .toarray()
lgbm_params_source: experiments/model_families/config.json models.LGBM (T4, a5d9ed5, unchanged) = T8 lgbm_params
categorical_params_policy: not passed; LightGBM 4.6.0 defaults (same as T8); effective values read from each saved model text
reference_oof_anchor: T8 design.json (O stratified, LR-C), T8 run/{scheme}/{arm}/metrics.json oof_sha256 and T8 run/analysis.json (audited PASS, b54b129)

lr_c_geo2_pooled_grade3_recall.source: pooled recall[2] of the pinned LR-C geo2 OOF (= T8 analysis.json)

sample_check.kind: real development data subsample; not a study fit; CSR-with-codes vs dense equivalent of the same matrix
sample_check.source_rows: stratified fold != 0 training rows only (no holdout)

primary_metric: unweighted mean of five fold Macro F1 (labels 1,2,3)

decomposition.formula: share = (mean_P - mean_O) / (mean_N - mean_O) on stratified fold-mean Macro F1
decomposition.note: share of the T8 stratified N-O gain retained by P; also reported for geo2/geo1 as descriptive values

combined_candidate.fold_win: P fold Macro F1 strictly greater than LR-C on the same fold
combined_candidate.label: combined candidate (needs separate pre-registered confirmation; no holdout, no final-model change)

rules.claims: report every result regardless of the judgment; selecting on the same folds is optimistic; no significance or causal claims
